# STC Marketing

> STC Marketing is a web design and direct mail marketing company based in Newberg, Oregon. We design, build, host, and manage custom websites for local businesses throughout Oregon, and we publish The Newberg Spotlight, a shared oversized direct mail postcard.

## Services

- **Web design and website management** — Custom websites designed from scratch (never templates) for local businesses. Every build includes mobile-first responsive layouts, fast load times, on-page SEO and real meta tags, hosting and domain management, security and software updates, and ongoing support after launch. Available throughout Oregon.
- **The Spotlights** — A shared 9x12" direct mail postcard featuring multiple local businesses, mailed to 5,000 households. Only one business per industry appears on each card. Ad design is included at no extra cost. Currently runs in Newberg, Oregon only.

## Service areas

Based in Newberg, Oregon. Website services are available statewide, with dedicated coverage in:

- **Yamhill County:** Newberg, Dundee, McMinnville, Lafayette, Carlton, Yamhill
- **Portland metro:** Sherwood, Tigard, Tualatin, Wilsonville, Lake Oswego, Beaverton, Hillsboro
- **Willamette Valley:** Corvallis

## Company facts

- Founded by brothers Silas and Solomon Capell
- Based in Newberg, Oregon; service-area business (no public storefront)
- Rated 5.0 out of 5 on Google
